svg.title: Measured playback and complete exports on every host
svg.desc: Reviewed observations + independently protected soundtrack + measured narration WAVs. Native voice: Windows SAPI / OneCore, macOS say, Linux eSpeak NG; optional OpenAI with consent. Plan safe gaps; keep no-fit events as pauses; unresolved facts block complete narrated media. Mix in-gap audio once; pause original soundtrack, insert narration; freeze picture for MP4. Extended MP4 / MP3 / WAV | original-time SRT / VTT / TXT / JSON + coverage; scripts cannot play pauses
